ramekin_cup.description: Small ceramic container with an open top.
ramekin_cup.function: Holds food or liquids and can be placed into an oven to bake.

teapot.description: Vessel that holds tea and contains a handle, body, and spout.
teapot.function: Holds tea and and is used to pour tea by holding the handle and pouring ouf of the spout.

mug.description: Holds liquids and can be drinken out of and contains a body, rim, base, and handle.
mug.function: Holds liquids and can be drinken out of by holding onto the handle and drinking out of the open top.

plate.description: Holds food and is used to be eaten from and contains a body, base, and rim.
plate.function: Holds food and solids and can be eaten from by holding the rim of the plate.

bowl.description: Holds food and liquids and is used to be eaten from or drink soup out of and contains a body, base, and rim.
bowl.function: Holds food and soups and can be eaten from or drinken from.

beer_bottle.description: Holds carbonated or fermented beverages and is used to store, pour, and drink beer from; contains a body, neck, and cap/opening.
beer_bottle.function: Holds and dispenses beer, allowing it to be poured directly from the bottle or drunk from the neck opening.

wine_glass.description: Stemmed glassware used for drinking wine; contains a bowl, stem, and rim.
wine_glass.function: Holds wine and is used to drink from by holding the stem and sipping from the rim.

vase.description: Decorative container typically used to hold flowers or as an ornamental piece; contains a body, handle(s), and rim.
vase.function: Holds flowers or serves as a decorative display piece, often filled with water and arranged stems.

wine_bottle.description: Holds wine and is used to store, pour, and serve it; contains a body and neck/pour opening.
wine_bottle.function: Holds wine and allows it to be poured out through the neck opening.

bottle.description: A condiment/mustard bottle used to store and dispense a liquid or paste condiment; contains a body and a dispenser tip.
bottle.function: Holds a condiment and allows it to be squeezed out through the dispenser onto food.

spoon.description: Eating utensil used to scoop and carry food or liquid to the mouth; contains a bowl and a handle.
spoon.function: Used to scoop food or liquid by holding the handle and bringing the bowl to the mouth.

ring.description: A piece of jewelry worn on the finger; contains a band and a jewel/setting.
ring.function: Worn on the finger as a decorative or symbolic accessory.

drink_bottle.description: Reusable bottle used to carry and drink beverages; contains a body, base, and neck/mouth opening.
drink_bottle.function: Holds a beverage and is used to drink from by tilting the bottle and drinking through the neck opening.

drinking_utensil.description: A kettle-like vessel used to hold and pour liquid; contains a body, base, lid, spout, and handle.
drinking_utensil.function: Holds liquid and is used to pour it out through the spout by holding the handle, with the lid covering the top opening.

pill_bottle.description: A cylindrical container used to store pills or medication; contains a body, base, and cap.
pill_bottle.function: Holds pills or medication, sealed by twisting the cap onto the body.
